label: Kripke's sceptical Wittgenstein: there is… attacks PU §201: there is a way of grasping a rule…
note: Exegetical/philosophical objection, not an exhaustive logical alternative. The full no-fact sceptical reconstruction concerns factual meaning determination and assertibility; noninterpretive grasp concerns practice/rule following and does not itself assert a fact determining a definite function. Existing interpretation-regress predicates supply an explicitly unattributed shadow of factual determination, not identities with either raw statement. No fact→no noninterpretive grasp bridge or proof of incompatibility is supplied. Refuting a stronger raw reconstruction must not automatically defend the other text reading. Source strengths and internal/external scopes remain intact. See docs/notes/scientism-meaning-rival-boundary.md.
